verdict.rationale:
PayPal documents a Disputes API for automating dispute management from external systems, which would let an agent programmatically retrieve and respond to disputes, and PayPal's Agent Toolkit connects popular agent frameworks to PayPal APIs via function calling. However, no evidence specifically shows the Agent Toolkit exposing dispute endpoints, evidence-upload/assembly capabilities, or an end-to-end agent workflow for disputes — only generic statements about the Disputes API and generic agent-toolkit integration.
missing for 10: dispute-specific agent toolkit functions, evidence-assembly/upload endpoint details, hands-on example of an agent completing a dispute end-to-end.
